name: Complete Account Recovery
summary: Completes recovery, revokes prior sessions and recovery material, then requires a fresh sign-in with the replacement credential.

preconditions.expression: recovery-state == credential-reset-required and durable-identity == resolved and replacement-credential-established == true

setup: Establish a replacement credential and complete all policy-required cleanup steps.

postconditions.expression: recovery-state == completed and session-capability == anonymous and previous sessions are revoked
